ieee1905_1::eMediaType beerocks::MediaType::get_802_11_media_type ( const beerocks::AgentDB::sRadio &  radio)
static

Gets media type for the given radio.

Media type value is obtained by checking the IEEE802.11 revisions supported. Returns UNKNOWN_MEDIA if media type can't be determined.

Parameters
radioReference on a radio object.
Returns
Media type value.

Gets media type for given interface.

The mechanism to use to obtain media type depends on the media type group: Ethernet, WiFi, MoCA, etc.

Parameters
[in]interface_nameName of the local interface.
